title: Asking the Bartender for Something Non-Alcoholic
meta: B2 · 约 240 词 · 场景：点无酒精饮品与婉拒劝酒

lines.en: Hey there, what are we having tonight?
**I'm not drinking tonight. What do you have that's alcohol-free but not too sweet?**
lines.zh: 我今晚不喝酒。有没有无酒精、又不太甜的？

lines.en: Good question. Most people just get a soda. Do you like something ==citrusy== or more ==bitter==?
lines.zh: 问得好。大多数人就点个汽水。你喜欢柑橘味的，还是偏苦一点的？

lines.en: Bitter, I think. Something that __feels like__ a proper drink, not a kids' juice.
lines.zh: 苦一点的吧。要有点正经喝酒的感觉，别像小孩喝的果汁。

lines.en: Then try our ==zero-proof== spritz. It's grapefruit, tonic and a non-alcoholic aperitif.
lines.zh: 那试试我们的零度气泡酒。西柚、汤力水，加一种无酒精开胃酒。

lines.en: Sounds good. Just to __double-check__, there's no alcohol in it at all? Not even a little?
lines.zh: 听着不错。我再确认一下，里面完全没有酒精吧？一点都没有？

lines.en: Good that you asked. Normally I add a dash of ==bitters==, and that does have alcohol. I'll __leave it out__.
lines.zh: 幸好你问了。平时我会加几滴苦精，那个是含酒精的。我不放就是了。

lines.en: Thanks, I appreciate that. I'm on medication this week, so I need to be careful.
lines.zh: 谢谢，很感激。我这周在吃药，得注意点。

lines.en: Here's your spritz. Oh, and your table's celebrating, right? The owner wants to send over a round of shots.
lines.zh: 你的气泡饮来了。对了，你们那桌在庆祝吧？老板想送一轮小杯烈酒。

lines.en: That's really ==generous== of him. The others will love it, but __count me out__, please.
lines.zh: 老板太大方了。其他人肯定喜欢，不过我就不要了。

lines.en: Are you sure? It's just one. Nobody's going to judge you.
lines.zh: 确定吗？就一小杯而已，没人会说你的。

lines.en: **Thanks, but I'll pass. Could you make me something fun to toast with instead?**
lines.zh: 谢谢，但我不喝了。能给我弄点好玩的、可以一起干杯的吗？

lines.en: Sure. How about a ginger and lime ==shooter== in the same glass? Nobody will know the difference.
lines.zh: 可以。用同样的杯子给你做一杯姜汁青柠小杯饮怎么样？别人看不出区别。

lines.en: That's perfect. I don't want to __make a big deal__ out of it.
lines.zh: 太好了。我不想把这事搞得太显眼。

lines.en: Totally get it. Happens more than you'd think. I'll bring them all over together.
lines.zh: 完全理解，这种情况比你想的多多了。我一起端过去。

lines.en: **You're a lifesaver. Can you put my drinks on the same tab as the table?**
lines.zh: 你真是救了我。我的饮品能记在那桌的账上吗？

gist.a: 完全无酒精、不太甜、偏苦一点、有喝酒感觉的饮品。

gist.q: 为什么「你」要再三确认没有酒精？调酒师发现了什么？
gist.a: 因为这周在吃药；调酒师说平时会加含酒精的苦精，这次不放。

gist.q: 老板送酒时「你」是怎么处理的？
gist.a: 礼貌拒绝，请调酒师用同样杯子做一杯姜汁青柠无酒精小杯饮，好一起干杯又不显眼。

prompts.q: 公司聚餐时，经理举着酒杯让你「至少喝一杯」。你不想喝，用轻松的方式拒绝，又不让场面冷下来。
prompts.ref: Thanks, really, but I'm sticking to soda tonight. I've got an early start with my son tomorrow, and he doesn't care how late I stayed out. But I'm definitely joining the toast, so fill my glass with soda. To a great quarter, everyone, and thanks for all the hard work.
prompts.ref_zh: 真的谢谢，但我今晚就喝汽水了。明天一早要陪儿子，他可不管我昨晚多晚回家。不过干杯我一定参加，给我倒上汽水。敬这个精彩的季度，大家辛苦了。

prompts.q: 在餐厅你想点一款无酒精啤酒，问服务员有没有、是什么牌子、酒精含量是否真的为零。
prompts.ref: Hi, do you have any non-alcoholic beer? If you do, which brand is it? I just want to check, is it completely zero alcohol, or is it the kind with a tiny bit in it? I'm driving tonight, so I'd rather be safe. If you don't have one, a ginger beer would be fine.
prompts.ref_zh: 你好，你们有无酒精啤酒吗？有的话是什么牌子？我想确认一下，是完全零酒精，还是含一点点的那种？我今晚要开车，想稳妥点。没有的话，来一杯姜汁汽水也行。
